title: M5Unified #455: clarify Buzzer isEnabled() and bound the build test wait

execution.environment: macOS arm64; ESP-IDF 6.1 (esp32c61 + esp32s3); arduino-cli 1.6.0 with esp32:esp32 3.3.13; Device Service cardputer-adv profile

checks.name: github_ci
checks.detail: 37/37 checks pass, including esp32c61 (IDF 6.1), Arduino 3.0.7/3.2.1/3.3.13/4.0.0 matrix and SourceCheck

checks.name: virtual_device_bounded_loop
checks.detail: IDF probe on cardputer-adv: loop_i=200 dt_ms=0 playing=1, delay20_ms=0; bound exits without hang, tone still playing

checks.name: virtual_device_build_test_body

notes: Non-blocking: under ESP-IDF CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100, M5.delay(1) is vTaskDelay(0), so the wait is 200 update() calls rather than about 200 ms; a 50 ms tone is still playing when the loop exits.
isEnabled() comment verified against the C61 attach path and tone() ordering: accurate.
The 200-iteration bound covers the case where both stop writes fail and _ioe1_playing would otherwise stay true forever.
